legal.case_number.description: The case_number column represents the number of precedents cited in a legal case. Format: number. If the document does not mention it: 0
legal.case_number.meaning: The case_number column represents the number of precedents cited in a legal case.

legal.case_type.description: The value in the column should be the exact type of legal case as stated in the document, such as 'Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', or 'Commercial Case'. If the document does not specify a case type, leave the field null. Format: string
legal.case_type.meaning: The value in the column should be the exact type of legal case as stated in the document, such as 'Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', or 'Commercial Case'. If the document does not specify a case type, leave the field null.

legal.evidence.description: Indicates whether evidence presented in the legal case is admissible (1) or not (0). Format: integer. If the document does not mention it: 0
legal.evidence.meaning: Indicates whether evidence presented in the legal case is admissible (1) or not (0).

legal.first_judge.description: The value represents whether a judge was assigned to the case, with 1 indicating that a judge was assigned. Format: 1 or 0. If the document does not mention it: 0
legal.first_judge.meaning: The value represents whether a judge was assigned to the case, with 1 indicating that a judge was assigned.

legal.hearing_year.description: The year in which the legal hearing took place. Format: number
legal.hearing_year.meaning: The year in which the legal hearing took place.

legal.judge_name.description: The value in the judge_name column is the name of the judge as stated in the document. Format: string
legal.judge_name.meaning: The value in the judge_name column is the name of the judge as stated in the document.

legal.judgment_year.description: The year in which the judgment was made. Format: number
legal.judgment_year.meaning: The year in which the judgment was made.

legal.legal_basis_num.description: The number of statutory bases or references used in a legal case document. Format: number. If the document does not mention it: 0
legal.legal_basis_num.meaning: The number of statutory bases or references used in a legal case document.

legal.plaintiff_current_status.description: The value in the plaintiff_current_status column should be written exactly as it is stated in the document. If the document does not mention a specific status, leave the field blank. Format: string
legal.plaintiff_current_status.meaning: The value in the plaintiff_current_status column should be written exactly as it is stated in the document. If the document does not mention a specific status, leave the field blank.
